name: app-cropped-savings-and-insights-screens-with-flow-map-of-nodes
title: Subscription App Screens, Cards and Flow Map
whatItIs: A tall white sheet with two cropped phones (a blue cloud savings header with 3D stars and a savings chart, and an insights screen with bars and an orange gauge on a metal ledge), floating component cards, and a flow map of pill nodes radiating from the app icon with items fading at the edges.
whatItMeans: Cropped screens and extracted cards show detail and structure, and the fading map implies more depth.
techniques: Cropped phones showing a screen fragment
Radial flow map from a central icon
Blue as the primary accent with orange gauge

vocabulary.definition: A map of screens radiating from a central node.
A UI card copied out of a screen and enlarged.
Elements fading toward the edge of a diagram.
